ios.desc:
Is your phone running out of space? Stop scrolling and start swiping!

Slider is the fastest and most addictive way to clean up your camera roll. Instead of hunting through thousands of files, Slider turns your gallery into a simple "Keep or Delete" stack.

Reclaim your storage in minutes. Whether it’s blurry selfies, accidental screenshots, or massive video files, Slider makes decluttering fun. It’s like Tinder for your photos—swipe left to trash it, swipe right to keep it!

HOW IT WORKS:

Swipe Left to move a photo or video to the trash.

Swipe Right to keep your favorite memories.

Review your deletions to make sure you didn't miss a gem.

Empty Trash and instantly free up gigabytes of space!

WHY YOU’LL LOVE SLIDER:

FULL VIDEO SUPPORT: Videos eat the most storage. Easily swipe through large video files to free up space instantly.

INTUITIVE GESTURES: No complex menus. The simple swipe mechanic makes cleaning your gallery feel like a game, not a chore.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU DELETE: You are always in control. Nothing is permanently deleted until you perform the final review.

PRIVACY FIRST: Slider works entirely on-device. Your photos and videos are never uploaded to a server or shared with anyone.

FAST & LIGHTWEIGHT: Designed for speed so you can clean 100 photos in under a minute.

Stop paying for extra iCloud storage just to hold onto junk files. Clear out the clutter, keep only your best shots, and get your storage back.

Download Slider today and finally get the clean gallery you deserve!

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
